title: Add bot difficulty levels for each game

pr.title: Add bot difficulty levels for each game
pr.body:
## Summary
- Players pick easy, mid, hard, or nightmare when entering a game. Mid and an omitted level keep today's bot, so the existing flow stays intact when the flag is off.
- Each engine scales search or policy with the level. The choice is stored on the match, and the web gate `game-difficulty` shows the level screen only on entry.
- Four web counters cover views, selects, starts, and errors.

## Test plan
- [ ] With the flag off, opening a game goes straight to the board and the bot plays as before.
- [ ] With the flag on, the level screen appears before the board. Easy is weaker than mid; hard and nightmare look further ahead where the game allows it.
- [ ] Starting a new game during play reuses the chosen level and does not ask again.
- [ ] Reloading an in-progress game offers resume and does not wipe the board.
- [ ] An unknown difficulty on `POST /api/games/:id/match/new` returns 400.

Players pick easy, mid, hard, or nightmare when entering a game. The choice is stored on the match and gated on the web, so an off flag still starts the board as before.
